meta.name: action-priority-matrix
meta.description: Compute Risk Priority Number (RPN = S x O x D), classify failure modes into H/M/L action priority per AIAG-VDA tables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算风险优先级数并分类失效模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行FMEA中的风险优先级计算与分类。
copy.tagline_en: Compute risk priority numbers and classify failure modes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to calculate risk priority numbers and classify failure modes in FMEA.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你给的严重性(S)、发生频率(O)和检测难度(D)分数，自动计算风险优先级数(RPN = S×O×D)，并按行业标准将故障模式分为高、中、低三个行动优先级，列出必须整改的高优先级项和边界案例。
howto.when: 当你提供三个分数列表（S、O、D），通常是在进行失效模式与影响分析(FMEA)时要求计算RPN和优先级分类时触发。

say.text: 计算这些故障模式的RPN并分类优先级。
say.note: 你会得到完整表格和行动要求。

say.text: 对以下S、O、D分数进行行动优先级分类。
列出需要立即整改的高优先级故障模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compute the Risk Priority Number (RPN = S × O × D) from your severity, occurrence, and detection scores, classify failure modes into High/Medium/Low action priority per industry standard tables, and list mandatory items and borderline cases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide three lists of scores (S, O, D), typically during a Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to calculate RPN and priority classification.

say_en.text: Compute RPN and classify priority for these failure modes.
say_en.note: Full table and action items returned.

say_en.text: Classify action priority for the given S, O, D scores.
List high-priority failure modes requiring immediate action.
